about: The Workbench icons of the BlobWars drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/blobwars.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/blobwars.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. BlobWars-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BlobWars.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BlobWars.info.
